method:
Execute original online file rank and outgoing storage fields offline.

The original format/class/config gates and native rank-sort tail execute
unchanged. Standard variant swapping copies the synthetic candidate records;
their heap/protobuf inputs remain oracle-owned. No original comparison or
preference decision is substituted. This excludes metadata eligibility and
native account/config producers, which must supply the explicit inputs.
limitations: Metadata validity, format presence and item eligibility are supplied inputs.
Raw account/config producers and backend-advised downgrade are separate.
No network, endpoint selection, transport, account access or Free entitlement claim.
